instructions.instruction: Finely grate your cabbage and your carrots within one bowl
Add your 3 large spoons of mayonnaise to the bowl with grated vegetables
Mix, add additional spoon if too dry
Add your two teaspoons of salt,mix and refrigirate
Cut your onions and finely grate your carrots
Fry your onions and carrots, for 5 minutes
Add your deboned pilchards, to your frying pan or pot
Add a pich of salt and fry for a few minutes
Once done, pour your meal into a glass or plastic container
Wait for it to cool down and add your tin of baked beans
Cut or shred your cucumber and mix it with your mayo in a bowl
Add your seasoning to your bowl and mix
Add your chicken into the bowl and mix
Once done mixing, leave your filling for a few minutes for the flavours to come together
Apply your filling to your bread slice and close it with another slice making a sandwich
Grill your sandwich or toast it
